identity.name: Remote WMI Process Execution via PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to execute a remote WMI process on a target host. Cortex should detect the WMI process execution and associated network activity.
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to execute a remote WMI process on a target host. Cortex should detect the WMI process execution and associated network activity.

payload.code: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$s = New-Object System.Management.ManagementScope("\\\\192.0.2.100\\root\\cimv2"); $q = New-Object System.Management.ObjectQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name = 'notepad.exe'"); $s = New-Object System.Management.ManagementObjectSearcher($s, $q); $s.Get();"

expected_artifacts.description: WMI remote connection to target host

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: WMI Remote Process Execution
biocs.description: Detection of WMI process execution via remote connection
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'wmic.exe' or action_file_path contains 'Get-WmiObject'

abiocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell WMI Execution
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from normal PowerShell usage involving WMI calls
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Get-WmiObject' or action_file_path contains 'Invoke-WmiMethod'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'

xql_queries.name: WMI Remote Process Execution Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Get-WmiObject'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
